Chengzhang for Even G2: talk an article into existence on your glasses, then settle the AI's notes with a tap.

**Try it on G2.** In the Even Realities app (developer mode), scan the QR code in the [README](https://github.com/Nowhitestar/Chengzhang-G2#on-your-g2-with-nothing-to-set-up), or open {{API_ORIGIN}}. The phone page asks once for an access code: `heads-up-g2`.

**The attached .ehpk** is the same app packed for Even Hub and pointed at {{API_ORIGIN}}. It is installed through Even Hub (`evenhub create` or `evenhub upload` with a developer account, then a beta or public channel), not opened directly.
